summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Project Management System Phase 3: Task Detail Modal with subtasks, checklists, comments, and time tracking. All features tested and working correctly.

issues: Minor: Missing DialogDescription or aria-describedby for accessibility - non-blocking

task_detail_modal_opening.trigger: Click on task card in Kanban board
features_verified: Modal opens when clicking any task card
Task name displayed in dialog title
Breadcrumb shows project and module name
Status field shows with colored indicator dot (Draft, Review, etc.)
Priority field shows with colored badge (High, Medium, etc.)
Assignee field shows with user icon and name (or 'Unassigned')
Due Date field shows with calendar icon and formatted date
Description section displays task description text
Edit button visible in modal header
Edit button toggles to Save/Cancel mode
Task name becomes editable input (data-testid='task-name-edit')
Status, Priority, Assignee, Due Date become dropdown selects
Description becomes textarea
Status dropdown shows all 7 options (Draft, Assigned, In Progress, Review, Completed, Approved, On Hold)
Cancel button reverts changes
Subtasks tab visible with count badge
Add subtask input field (data-testid='subtask-input')
Plus button adds new subtask with toast confirmation
Subtask items display with circle/check icons
Toggle button marks subtask complete/incomplete
Delete button removes subtask with toast confirmation
Empty state shows 'No subtasks yet'
Checklist tab visible with completed/total badge (e.g., '0/2')
Progress bar shows completion percentage
Add checklist item input field (data-testid='checklist-input')
Plus button adds new item
Items display with circle/check icons for toggle
Toggle button marks item complete/incomplete
Delete button removes item (revealed on hover)
Empty state shows 'No checklist items'
Comments tab visible with count badge
Textarea for writing comments (data-testid='comment-input')
Post Comment button adds comment
Comments display with author avatar, name, timestamp
Comment content displays with proper formatting
Delete button removes comment (revealed on hover)
Empty state shows 'No comments yet'
Time tab visible
Summary cards show Estimated, Logged, Remaining hours
Estimated shows '-h' when not set
Logged shows total from time logs (e.g., '2.5h')
Remaining calculates correctly
Log Time button opens form
Hours input field (data-testid='time-hours-input')
Description input field for work notes
Log Time form submit creates entry with toast
Time log entries display with user, hours, description, date

critical_code_review_comments: Code is well-structured with separate section components (SubtasksSection, ChecklistsSection, CommentsSection, TimeLogsSection)
Proper use of data-testid attributes for testability
API base URL correctly uses environment variable
Good error handling with toast notifications
Minor: DialogContent should have DialogDescription for accessibility
